title: xAI API reports cached_tokens > prompt_tokens, causing >100% cache rate display
description: The xAI (Grok) API sometimes reports cachedTokens larger than promptTokens on individual LLM responses. This was observed in 2 games (both Grok 4.1 Fast, epoch 20): game_20260219_091818_g2 (148.6% cache rate) and game_20260219_091818_g7 (109.0% cache rate). On individual responses, cached tokens are roughly 2x the prompt tokens (e.g., prompt=5138 cached=9280). This causes the internals Trends page to display >100% cache rates for affected games, which is misleading. Options: (a) clamp cache% to 100% in the chart display, (b) clamp at data generation time in leaderboard.py, or (c) investigate whether the xAI SDK has a different semantic for cached_tokens.
